name: Climbmon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand. If you have 3 or fewer, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text and 6000 DP or less from your trash without paying the cost. At the next end of your opponent's turn, delete it.
source_effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, by trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
